title: Notifications off disables Send; no permission hides it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A worklist row for a customer whose "Maintenance notifications" toggle is OFF (customer information card), with a contact that has an email.
  4. A second user WITHOUT the create and edit customers permission (view customers only).
custom_steps:
1. Open the row's Contact card and read the send control and the text beside it.
  2. Check that the row is still on the worklist with its tiles counted as before.
  3. Still as the advisor, read the lines under the email address on that card.
  4. On the customer information card turn "Maintenance notifications" on, send a reminder from the row's Contact card, turn the toggle off again and reopen the Contact card.
  5. Sign in as the user without create and edit customers and open the same card; look for Send reminder.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Send reminder is shown but disabled, with the reason beside it naming the setting (e.g. "Notifications off for this customer").
  • The row is still listed; nothing is hidden from the worklist because of the setting.
  • On the design the card reads "Notifications off for this customer" and offers "Turn on for this customer" (a design-only shortcut the description does not ask for: write down whether you see it; do not pass or fail on it).
  • The last-sent line still shows the date of that send while Send reminder is disabled (on the design it reads e.g. "Last sent 12 Aug, before it was turned off"; write down the words you see; do not pass or fail on the wording).
  • This user does not see Send reminder at all (hidden, not disabled).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S14 (S14-R9, S14-R10, S14-N1, S14-N5); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard B1o; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-N1: “Where the customer's notification setting is off, Send reminder is disabled with the reason shown beside it, not hidden”
  • Design board, artboard B1o: “Notifications off for this customer”
  • S14-R9: “Where the customer's notification setting is off, the row still appears and the send action is unavailable, naming that setting as the reason”
  • S14-N5: “Nothing is hidden from the worklist because of the notification setting. It affects sending and nothing else”
  • S14-R10: “A user without it does not see Send reminder at all, hidden rather than disabled, because it is not something they can fix from the card”
  • Design board, artboard B1o: “Notifications off for this customer”
  • Design board, artboard B1o: “Turn on for this customer”
  • Design board, artboard B1o: “Last sent 12 Aug, before it was turned off”
